sections.title: Guinea-Pig Journalism
sections.description: Students will study and practice the genre of immersion journalism, in which a writer seeks out new experiences for first-person narratives that can take the form of travel writing, undercover investigative reporting, or hilarious narratives of unusual self-experiments. To learn more about this course, visit the Creative Writing Program at https://creative.writing.upenn.edu.
